title: Decision to Leave - The Monday Granny

commenti.body: Seo-rae’s alibi is provided by the granny: if it was monday = Seo-rae was here. The purpose of Hae-jun asking the final question is to see whether she will instinctively say that Seo-rae was there because it is monday, which she does. I don’t think they explicitly pull the grandma to the station to interrogate her, but I recall a scene where Hae-jun’s partner is talking to the granny and I think they mention then or at another point that her alibi was clean because she was at the nursing home.

Ahhh okay this makes a lot more sense. I thought that the granny did see Seo-rae come in on the day of the murder but I guess the flashback visualization scene shows the granny sleeping as Seo-rae switches out her phone with the grandma's. So the granny didn't ACTUALLY see Seo-rae come into her house but just automatically thought she did cuz it was a monday.

You have it backwards. Seo-Rae came on another day but because she always comes on Mondays, Granny thought it was Monday. If she sees Seo she thinks it’s Monday, even if it isn’t. She does not a great grip on time because she stays home all day and is elderly. Her only way to mark the passage of time is through routine. So she has no way of knowing or even suspecting that Seo could have come by on a day that isn’t Monday.

Okay but wasn't it a Monday anyways when Seo-rae infiltrated the granny's house to switch her phone with the granny's? Obviously it had to be, because you know...the husband died on a Monday. It was a Monday morning when she switched her phone, went to the mountain and killed her husband. It wasn't like the murder took place on another day. So I'm wondering what's the significance of the granny not knowing what day it is.

I could be wrong but I think they show the grandma sleeping when she switches the phones. Either way she wouldn’t have been there at the time of the murder. The point is just that the granny has been conditioned to say that if it was monday, Seo-rae was there. Seo-rar tells the cops she was at the nursing home at the time of the murder, and when the cops come asking ”was Seo-rae here on monday the blablabla?” granny knows to answer yes because it was on a monday
